choices.why: This light birch rectangular table, 125 × 74 cm, seats four comfortably without crowding the free floor beside the kitchenette, and its pale wood picks up the kitchen's light wood cabinetry.
These simple black wooden chairs have a sturdy Nordic frame that matches the table's leg design, giving a clean black-and-light-wood contrast.
This minimalist white bell pendant blends with the white walls and ceiling and suits the simple Nordic look over the table.
This low 120 cm two-door cabinet in matte white sits quietly against the white wall and echoes the kitchen's white upper cabinets without taking up visual space.

answer.why: Light birch, matte black and white form a simple Nordic palette that repeats the kitchenette's pale wood and white cabinets. The compact sizes keep the open studio airy.
